obligations.finding: All finite N,k; strict contractions; U tensor I; centered blocks.
Right polar convention and zero-kernel independence.
Opposite determinant orientation is complex conjugate.
Exactly Nk nonnegative singular parameters and S=sum logcosh t.
Pinned primary EMI for every Ky Fan 2l norm at size 2Nk.
All singular partial sums decrease under site pinching.
Elementary spectral-Jensen proof; no operator convexity assumption.
Real HS gradient V tanh|A|, including zero/singular A.
Scalar site resolvent row and column absolute bounds <=K.
Complex matrices, signed real site coefficients, unused mass at zero.
Sum Z=0 gives translated-Phi minimization; no sum W=0 assumption.
N=1, k=1, C=1, zero/singular blocks and all strict-boundary approaches.

computation_verdict: Exact finite identities verified; floating diagnostics conditional on tolerance, sampling and external numerical libraries; no universal inference.
